name: program-lean
description: The program's lean screen, about 16 minutes a build on the ring: model behaviour on 64 prompts at 16 streams (it also heat-soaks the GPU; arms after the first score the first arm's text), the engine grid (the text-independent step cost at 1-16 requests), a closed loop at 8 streams and the single stream (each request a different prompt, thinking off), 240 s each after 60 s warm-up, and cold real-text prefill at 32K and 131K, three repeats. Built for experiments/2026-10-26-cluster-program; not a release suite.
